output.summary: Agency spend growth is mostly volume (about 77%), not price (about 23%, tied to a contractual wage-index escalator). Vacancies and resignations have risen steadily since early 2024, before St. Brennan's opened in March 2026. A workload loop is supported: unit-level lagged correlations peak at two quarters, the exit-interview top reason is workload at 49% (pay 17%), and the 4 West pilot cut charge load and exhaustion, with resignations falling against matched units. The 2025 sign-on bonus did not stop vacancy growth, and the CFO plan would suspend the charge and preceptor differentials, which worsens the loop. Extend the 4 West model. Treat rate renegotiation as a secondary lever. Time-to-hire and the falls link remain unestablished.
